title: Keeping the installed service definition of the replica daemon equal to what the code renders
description: The replica daemon renders its own service definition (LaunchAgent plist, systemd unit, Scheduled Task) from the topology and, when the installed definition differs from it, installs the rendered one at a safe point: the difference must persist for the quiet period (the same debounce as a code restart) and no sidecar may be in the middle of a restart. The previous definition is kept and restored when the platform cannot load the new one. `state.json` below `<entry>/service-definition` remembers the difference being waited for and the last applied digest (Windows cannot return the installed task byte for byte); `result.json` is written by the detached macOS helper once the reload is over.

pendingDigest.description: sha256 of the rendered definitions that differ from the installed ones, empty when nothing is pending.

pendingMs.description: When that difference was first seen.

reportedMs.description: The time of the last helper result that was reported.

en.pending: service definition differs from the code, installing it after {seconds} s without a further change
en.reloading: service definition installed, the service manager reloads {services} now
en.restored: the service manager could not load the new service definition, the previous one is back ({reason})
en.failed: the service manager could not load either service definition ({reason}); log in again to start the service
en.needsPrivilege: service definition differs from the code but {path} cannot be written by this account; the fixed bootstrap unit is installed once with privileges, afterwards every change needs none: {command}

de.pending: Die Dienstdefinition weicht vom Code ab, sie wird nach {seconds} s ohne weitere Änderung installiert
de.reloading: Dienstdefinition installiert, der Dienstmanager lädt {services} jetzt neu
de.restored: Der Dienstmanager konnte die neue Dienstdefinition nicht laden, die vorherige ist wieder da ({reason})
